announcement.msg_id: ARA 4.9.4 — toolbar baru "ARA Lampu" di SketchUp: Lampu Indirek, Downlight, dan Lampu Bidang yang tampak langsung di viewport dan dibaca Gemini saat render. Edisi kantor: ARA dibuka tanpa proyek (tombol PROYEK merah) dan bertanya sebelum GENERATE bila proyek belum dipilih — render tak lagi masuk proyek yang salah. Mohon perbarui: unduh di github.com/gigihwicaksono09-spec/ARA_AURUM/releases (SmartScreen: More info → Run anyway).
announcement.msg_en: ARA 4.9.4 — new "ARA Lampu" toolbar in SketchUp: Indirect Light, Downlight and Glowing Surface lights visible right in the viewport and read by Gemini when rendering. Office edition: ARA starts with no project (PROJECT button red) and asks before GENERATE when no project is selected — renders no longer land in the wrong project. Please update: download at github.com/gigihwicaksono09-spec/ARA_AURUM/releases (SmartScreen: More info → Run anyway).
